arcs.title: The Duck Waits
arcs.summary: Day 3: A bootprint — left foot, partial, facing the passenger-side mirror — has been found at the edge of the drive. The Bandit was here between last light Wednesday and first light Thursday. Lucy did not bark and claims 'insufficient grounds for escalation,' which suggests prior knowledge of the visitor. The two ducks remain undisturbed at forty-seven degrees. Don's portrait notes the print is a size eleven. Day 4 should narrow the identity further: either a second physical token left by the Bandit (a small marked object, or a note), or a connection drawn between the size-eleven boot and someone known to have been near Harlan's Creek on the morning of the expedition — a named figure from the trail community, a familiar, or an unexpected party. Lucy's prior knowledge should be addressed or deepened.
